name: Arturia MiniLab 3
source: SHR-DAW direct MIDI learn on the formerly connected MiniLab 3: ordinary relative encoder CC 114, Shift CC 9, Shift+main-encoder CC 112, and click CC 115 on channel 1, with factory pads on channel 10. Its positional parameter knobs are intentionally not mapped by the direction-only rotary contract; the earlier directly reviewed DAW-mode Shift CC 27 and shifted encoder CC 29 remain a compatibility variant; https://support.arturia.com/hc/en-us/articles/6189475866396-MiniLab-3-General-Questions

name: Arturia MiniLab mkII
source: Arturia documents sixteen assignable encoders, clickable encoders 1 and 9, and two banks on eight physical pads. This partial profile intentionally maps no MIDI messages until direct SHR-DAW MIDI Learn verifies the selected hardware memory; https://downloads.arturia.com/products/minilab-mkII/manual/MiniLabmkII_Manual_1_0_7_EN.pdf
